set.def: the power in your body that lets you move, work, and play

why: def described stamina ('for a long time'); 'strength' is not a synonym of energy
'probable' is too hard for a starter-level synonym question
'bond' is not a simple or exact synonym at starter level
'study' is not a synonym of learn (you can study without learning)
'believe' (accept as true) is not a synonym of trust (rely on someone)
'copy' is not a true synonym of a scale model
'concentrate' is harder than the headword; starter syn must be very simple
'often' does not mean 'most of the time'

why: def limited to jobs, but ex/cloze show dogs and runners
